matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 111-120 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages match the current extraction and require no correction. Page 115 was already present in the complete-page ledger from the stratified random audit, and page 117 was already recorded as reviewed after correction; this bundle therefore adds eight newly complete pages and 368 rows without double counting. Literal source anomalies, apparent misspellings, duplicate rows, incomplete names, clipped notes, foreign names, civilian grades, ranks, and column occupancy remain unchanged. Examples preserved include DeJussieu-Po, Geroge Delmas, Gelnn Dickerson, Diebod,Jr., Norwegi, and clipped note text. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
